derivations.method: STA printed '01:55/23:55Z+1'; the '+1' belongs to the ARN local time, so the Zulu value is 2026-09-03T23:55Z (to_utc: ARN 2026-09-04T01:55 local = 2026-09-03T23:55Z). Only the calendar date was derived; the clock value is printed.

Off Duty printed '00:50/23:50Z+1'; the '+1' is the LHR local rollover, so the Zulu date stays 2026-09-04 (to_utc: LHR 2026-09-05T00:20 local = 2026-09-04T23:20Z, confirming the +1 marks local only). Endtime 2026-09-04T23:50Z.

'00:20/22:20Z+1' and '01:21/23:21Z+1' resolve to 2026-09-08T22:20Z and 2026-09-08T23:21Z; to_utc confirms BCN 2026-09-09T01:21 local = 2026-09-08T23:21Z. The following arrival '02:26/01:26Z+1' does roll into 2026-09-09 in UTC.

Not derived from any offset: the SIM row's printed Report '08:00/07:00Z' is taken as-is (2026-09-11T07:00Z) because training report is the stated start of the window with no flight reporting offset applied.
